finalText:
I combined the three reports of the CRM account-search 500 error into one ticket, T-1052. It's now graded sev2 and assigned to Ines Kovac (E-201).

- **Merged:** T-1053 and T-1054 are now part of T-1052. All three describe the same problem: every account search returns a server error, starting around 07:00. T-1052 stays open because it was reported first.
- **Severity:** T-1053 said the whole Revenue Ops department is blocked, so the combined ticket's impact is "department". For CRM, the escalation matrix rates that as sev2, so I raised it from sev3.
- **Deadline:** 2026-03-17 at 12:40 UTC. That's the earliest deadline already promised on any of the three tickets (it came from T-1053), so nothing was moved earlier.
- **Assignee:** Ines Kovac is on call for business-apps, the team that owns CRM, when the deadline falls. Her shift runs 08:00–20:00 UTC. This replaces Tomas Lindqvist (E-202), who had T-1053 but isn't the on-call engineer at that time.
- **Link and comment:** T-1054's link to T-1061 now points to T-1052. I left a comment on T-1052 explaining all of the above.

**Left alone:**
- **T-1055** (CSV export gives an empty file) is a different problem; the reporter says search works fine for them.
- **T-1061** is the engineering ticket tracking the search index rebuild, not a user report of the error, so I didn't merge it.

I didn't escalate the ticket, because you asked for it to be graded and assigned. If you want it escalated, the matrix sends sev2 tickets to the platform-primary rotation. Also, the 12:40 UTC deadline is about 3h20m after the service desk's current time of 09:20 UTC.
